lines: The old slide? I looked it up in the town records. Well, I tried to.
Every page about it has been torn out. Every single one. All it says is "The Incident", and then a little drawing of a ghost.
Rex and I come from the future, and even WE don't know what happened. That's... actually pretty spooky.
Rex's Doggie Bill of Rights? Of course I'll sign. He's my twin. Even if he's furrier than me right now.
(Dash signs: DASH, with a little lightning bolt.)
Don't tell him, but I think being a husky's made him nicer. He used to never think about anyone else.
You've got a shell too? I keep wanting to sniff everything. EVERYTHING. Is that a lamp post? Sniff. Is that you? Sniff.
Rex says this is what it's like every day for him. Huh.
There you are, {player}! Look up. No, really, look up.
The stars over Observatory Hill keep blinking in a pattern. Tick, tick, tick. Like a clock. I don't like it.
Go up to the Observatory and have a look, will you? And keep your eyes open on the way. I dropped... I mean, I think there's a schematic round the far side of that hill!
It's for a ride, so take it to Zippy. Zippy builds rides faster than I can say "tailwhip".
BZZZT! (Sparks fly. A boy in a cap and goggles pops up from behind the workbench.) Oh! Hi! You found my lab!
{player}: Rex said you dropped these. (You hand over the coil, the bulb and the cog.)
My bits! THANK you. I'm Dash! Rex's twin. The one who isn't a husky right now. That's a long story.
I'm building a Buzz Bot: a little helper that blows bubbles at Gloops. It's nearly done. I just need to pop the cog... in... (CLICK.)
(The Buzz Bot whirrs, blinks its teal eye, and zooms straight out of the lab.)
NO NO NO! Come back! {player}, can you catch it? Just walk right into it. It doesn't bite. It barely even buzzes.
It's zooming round and round out the front! Walk right into it and it'll stop. Probably.
You caught it! (Dash hugs the Buzz Bot. It buzzes happily.) You're a natural!
OK, you've earned it. I've got a gadget stall in the Market Square, by the fountain. Gadgets do even sillier things than bubbles!
My best one's the Star Popper. It blows bubbles that pop Gloops from a long way off. But I can only build one from its blueprint...
...and SOMEBODY left the window open. (He looks at the Buzz Bot. The Buzz Bot looks away.) It blew off towards the Market.
It glows blue. Find it, and meet me at my stall!
Found the blueprint yet? It glows blue, somewhere near the Market. Bring it to my stall and I'll build you a Star Popper for a few sparkles.
Your very own Star Popper! Press {shoot} to blow a bubble, and hold {aim} to aim.
Have a look round my stall while you're here. New gadgets need their own blueprints. They blow about all over the Void, glowing blue!
Have a look at my stall! Gadgets, refills, the lot. That's my workbench next to it, for mods.
YOU DID IT! You popped the GLOOP KING! I saw the whole thing! Bubbles everywhere!
{player}: He was SO bouncy.
And look what he dropped. His crown! It's yours. Champion of the west fields!
(The Buzz Bot does a little loop-the-loop over your head.) See? Even Buzzy's impressed.
Oh! I nearly forgot. My friend Pip's been waiting by the portal ALL day. They've got something to show you. Go on!
Everyone's whispering about the Gloop King. Biggest, goldest Gloop there is. He's got a whole kingdom, through a gooey gate in the west fields, just past here.
Watch out for his belly-flop! It sends a ring of goo across the ground. Jump over it!
Bubbles make him wobble. Keep popping and he'll pop too. I'll cheer from here!
Pip's by the portal! Go on, go on! They glow when they're happy. You'll see.
(A boy in a cap and goggles zooms past on a bike, a box of wires bouncing in the basket.) Can't stop! Experiment! Big one! Bye!
Hi! Rex is so excited. Talk to him, he's doing a whole tour.
Watch the pink pointer on your watch's rim. The faster it pulses, the closer the ripple. Then just walk into it!
Rook won't come for us. Maybe he'll come for you? He's very food-motivated. And ball-motivated.
Ripples loaded, pods sealed, ball supplied. The big lever's on the console. It's probably safe!
{player}: Probably?
Very probably.
Go on, ask Rex. I want to see his face.
Whoa, hey! {player}! I mean... hi, stranger I have definitely never met before.
{player}: Do I know you?
Not yet! Well... kind of. It's complicated. Time stuff.
I'm Dash. I came here through the pond to fix something. A super important something.
{player}: What are you fixing?
Can't say! If I talk about the future too much it makes time ripples. Little wobbly ones.
{player}: Dash, Rex is running for mayor. What would you want a mayor to do?
A mayor? Rex? My twin brother Rex?
(Dash thinks about it, very fast.)
Okay, okay! A bike lane all the way round the lake! So I can zoom without bumping into anybody.
And tell him if he wins, I'm still not calling him Mayor Rex at breakfast.
{player}: Dash, I found this at the bottom of the water. When I held it, I heard voices.
(Dash goes very quiet.)
That's from our lab. From the night it happened, back in the far future. How did it get all the way down there?
Time drops things, I think. Like a pocket with a hole in it. They fall out, and they sink, and the deep water holds them still.
Bring me every piece you find, {player}. I need to know exactly what happened that night.

rotate: {player}: Another piece of that night, Dash.
(Dash turns it over and over in his hands.) I remember this. I really do.
{player}: I found another one. It was right at the bottom.
(Dash holds it up to his ear, like it might still be humming.)

lines: {player}: Dash, I found this watch. It's a funny one.
(Dash's eyes go very wide.)
A lost watch! Everyone who lands here brings one. It tracks time the way it worked back home, wherever and whenever home was.
Some of the chosen kids have lost theirs. I'm collecting them. Trying to work out when everyone is from.
{player}: Why?
Can't say! Time ripples. Wobble wobble. But if you find more, bring them to me?
That's {watches_given} of 20. I'll keep it safe, promise.

rotate: Ooh, let me see! Hmm. This one's from a long way away. Or a long time away. Or both!
(Dash holds it up to his ear and listens, very seriously.)
Ticking like it's in a hurry. That's {watches_given} now!
Yes! You're a time detective. {watches_given} down, {watches_left} to go.

lines: Do you feel that? The portal's open! Time's all slow and stretchy right now.
{player}: Is that where you came from?
Ha! Uh... no comment. Time ripples, remember? Wobble wobble.
Out for a ride! Wind in my hair! ...Well, in my hat.
{player}: Where are you going?
Everywhere! Twice! Riding helps me think about... stuff. Future stuff. Shh.
Snack break! Do you know what they have for snacks in the fu-
(Dash claps a hand over his mouth.)
...Crackers. They have crackers. Totally normal crackers.
Sunsets here are the best. Pink and purple and a little bit sparkly.
{player}: Better than the ones where you come from?
Ha! Nice try. No comment.
(Dash yawns a giant yawn.)
Morning, {player}. Bike's ready. Brain's still... loading.
Hey, {player}. If you ever find a watch lying around, a funny-looking one, bring it to me?
People drop them when they land here. Whoosh, plonk. Gone.
{player}: What do they look like?
All different! Everybody counts time their own way. Sundials, hourglasses, beepy ones... Look up high, and down low.
Can't sleep. My brain's going boots-and-cats, boots-and-cats.
{player}: Boots and... cats?
That's how you say house music with your mouth! Try it! Boots-and-cats!
Morning! I already rode around the lake eleven times. Twelve. I lost count.
(Dash leans on his bike. The bike wobbles. Dash wobbles.)
I'm fine!

rotate: Leaning on my bike is my favorite way to stand. Ask anyone. Ask the bike.
The bike has never complained. Not once. Best friend ever.
Psst. Want to know something about the future?

lines: Okay. In the future, there's this giant...
(Dash stops. He squints at the sky.)
...nope. I felt a ripple. Sorry! Ask me again in, like, a hundred years.
Smart. Super smart. You'd be amazing at time travel.

rotate: Untz, untz, untz. That's the beat.
It's always playing in my head. It's a good song. You'd love it. Untz.
